nextStoryContext: All 39 test/commands/**/*.test.ts files that rooted a temp dir in the OS temp dir are migrated onto createTestTmpdir via scripts/codemod-test-tmpdir.ts, matching the PRD's informative reference exactly (75 occurrences across 39 files swept RED on main, confirmed clean at the start of this story before running the codemod). One codemod invocation covering all 39 files rewrote every site in one pass with zero hand-edits: bun run typecheck came back immediately clean (no unpruned node:os/node:fs/node:path imports), so neither of the two US-004 edge-case bugs (multi-statement same-module import, prose-quoted identifier in a describe/test title) recurred in this subtree. GOTCHA 10 re-check swept negative across all three axes for test/commands: no file does its own `git init` inside the scratch dir, no test asserts a spawned script fails for a missing dependency, and no file spawns real tmux panes or asserts an absolute-path prefix -- test/commands/** exercises command entrypoints against fake spawn functions, not real git/tmux subprocesses, unlike test/supervisor/** (US-004, done) and the upcoming test/integration/** (US-006), which the PRD notes flag as the dominant GOTCHA 10(c) risk (real tmux pane spawns, longer in-repo paths). file-size-budget.json needed NO raise this story (bun run check:all's file-size gate passed clean with no changes). Remaining rooting sites for US-006 (test/integration/**, 31 files incl. the bare path-join sentinel at plan-runner-pane-spawn.test.ts:161) and US-007 (26 files across test/config, test/release, test/unit, test/orchestrator, test/transcript, test/issues, test/vendor, test/plan, test/notify, test/logging, test/interactivity, test/fixtures, test/domain-docs, test/retry -- test/retry's MIT headers must survive byte-for-byte per the curated invariant, and its awaited `await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(...))` form needs the same synchronous createTestTmpdir call, which already works fine under await since awaiting a non-promise resolves immediately) are outside this subtree; grep test/ (excluding test/supervisor, test/commands, and top-level test/*.test.ts) for `join(tmpdir()` to find the next front's file list. GOTCHA 11 (test/vendor/check-agent-frontmatter-standalone.test.ts budget) belongs to US-007, not this story: raising that budget is explicitly forbidden as a fix, only the migration itself resolves it.
